reference.title: Scenario 6: Paragraph between a bullet list item
reference.shortdesc: Consider a .md file about notification methods with a list where a list item contains

section.p: Consider a .md file about notification methods with a list where a list item contains additional explanatory text in a continuation paragraph.

table.title: Paragraph between a bullet list item

entry.codeblock: # Notification Methods - Email Notifications Email notifications are sent to configured recipients whenever an alarm is triggered. - SMS Notifications SMS notifications provide immediate alerts to mobile devices. - Webhook Notifications Webhook notifications send alarm data to external systems.

Notification Methods

  • Email Notifications

    Email notifications are sent to configured recipients whenever an alarm is triggered.

  • SMS Notifications

    SMS notifications provide immediate alerts to mobile devices.

  • Webhook Notifications

    Webhook notifications send alarm data to external systems.

section.p: Result: The converter preserves both the list item and its continuation paragraph. The list item becomes a DITA <li> element, and the continuation text is converted into an additional paragraph within the same list item. This maintains the relationship between the list item and its supporting explanation.
